decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on actual speakers rather than accessories like cases or shelves. I narrowed my consideration set to high-performing portable units from top-tier brands (JBL, Bose, Sony) and one high-volume budget alternative (EWA). The JBL Flip 5 was selected as the final choice because it offers the highest rating in the set (4.8) combined with an extremely large volume of reviews, indicating consistent performance. At $89.95, it is more reasonably priced than the Bose or Sony models while being a new (not renewed) product, making it the most attractive option for a reliable portable speaker.
